BOOKS.title: 前漢書·卷三十六~卷三十七 (Hanshu, Siku Quanshu Huiyao copy, juan 36-37)
BOOKS.author: 班固 (Ban Gu)
BOOKS.note: #8053 fills the gap in the Four Histories 漢書 (#7546): the 欽定四庫全書 copy's vol. 25 ends at juan 36 leaf 36a and no volume holds juan 37. This volume is ANOTHER COPY: IA files it as 摛澡堂四庫全書薈要·史部·正史類 (本书100卷，拆分成56册), item 06079788.cn of run 06073027-06079820, while the other 57 volumes are the 欽定四庫全書 run 06058710-807. Its content was checked by eye on the leaves (2026-11-04): n3 is juan 36 leaf 2 (楚元王交 … 丘嫂), n75 is juan 36 leaf 38 (劉向's memorial on the Wang clan), n128 ends 前漢書卷三十七考證 (田叔傳). It repeats juan 36 leaves 1-36a, which the other copy holds. IA's creator field (范蔚宗) is wrong; the author is 班固. Year: the 摛澡堂 Huiyao copy, c. 1778.
